title: Record parsing and strict validation
description: Parse person, tier, endorsement, revocation and anchors.json per DESIGN.md. git-vouch context must be first in @context. Own terms checked strictly for type/format (handles, did:keys, ISO dates, tier enum, reason); unknown terms ignored. handle must match file name. Automation person files require accountable.
acceptance_criteria: Table-driven tests of valid and invalid records for each kind, including wrong types, bad handles, missing context, oversize files, handle/file-name mismatch.
